home.title: Ditiro tse di Tlhamaletseng tsa Motho yo o Tlhokomelang Motho
home.description: Ditiro tse di tlhamaletseng tse di tlhwatlhwa tsa motho yo o tlhokomelang motho: dithoro, dilo tsa bana, ditiro tsa go dirwa mmogo le maikutlo a a kgutsa a boitlhamelo.
home.eyebrow: Mahala · Ga go dikgangiso · Ga go ikwadisa · Ga go dinako kgotsa dipontsho
home.lede: Bona ketelo e e tshwanetseng motho, nako le se o nang le sone. Dithoro tse di bonolo, boitlhamelo jwa bana, dilo tsa go dirwa mmogo le maikutlo a a kgutsa a boitlhamelo, le ditlhopho tse di bonolo go feta le kadi ya go e gatisa. Ema fa o rata.
facts: E dirisiwa mo mogaleng, mo thebolete le mo khomputareng
Ditshwantsho tse dikgolo di nna di bonala
Ema nako nngwe le nngwe; ga go na sepe se se ka palelang
home.heroApp: Gape ke application e mahala ya iPhone, iPad le Android, e nang le ditshwantsho tsa lelapa la gago
home.albumNote: “Ditshwantsho tse pedi tsa kopi ya tee, mmogo.”
home.gamesTitle: Dipapadi tse o ka di bapalang jaanong
home.gamesLede: Nngwe le nngwe e a itumedisa, e bonolo mme e a simolola ka lebelo. Tlhopha nngwe, dulang fa thoko ga go le ngwe, mme le ntshe ka go tsaya dikgetho.

steps.title: Tlhopha sengwe se o se itseng
steps.text: Ditshwantsho tsa dikopi tsa tee, marapo, diphologolo le dikepe tsa mekgabiso. Ga go tlhokege go ithuta go bala kgotsa melao pele.

steps.title: Dulang fa thoko ga go le ngwe
steps.text: Ba leke go tobetsa. Buang ka ditshwantsho. Ditshwantsho tse di sa tshwaneng di emela tobetso e e latelang.

steps.title: Ema fa go ntse go monate
steps.text: Papadi e le nngwe ke ditiro tse di feletseng. “Ke tlogela jaanong” e nna mo skrineng ka metlha.

home.stageTitle: Dikgopolo tsa ditiro tsa kgato nngwe le nngwe
home.stageLede: Mmino, ditiro tsa letsatsi le letsatsi, go gopola dikgang tsa kgale le metlhala e e thusang go itumelela ka dinako tse di khutshwane, e e tsamaisanang le se se phepafetseng jaanong.

stages.title: Kgato ya pele
stages.text: Tswelela go dira se ba se ratang, ka diphetogo tse nnye: dikgatlhego, go tsamaya kwa ntle, dipapadi tsa mafoko le go rera mmogo.
stages.label: Dikgopolo tsa kgato ya pele

stages.title: Kgato ya bogare
stages.text: Ditiro tse di bonolo, tse di tlwaelegileng, di kgaolwa dikgato: go phuthela, go aroganya, mmino, dipapadi tsa ditshwantsho le go tsamaya ka dinyana.
stages.label: Dikgopolo tsa kgato ya bogare

stages.title: Kgato ya bofelo
stages.text: Go itumedisa le go kopana ka go ama, modumo le pono: tlhokomelo ya diatla, dipina tse ba di ratang, ditshwantsho le go nna mmogo.
stages.label: Dikgopolo tsa kgato ya bofelo

home.specificHtml: A o batla sengwe se se tlhomameng? Leka ditiro le dipapadi tsa Alzheimer's, ditshwantsho le dipapadi tsa tafole, dipapadi tsa puo kgotsa ditshwantsho.
home.approachTitle: Ketelo e e abelanwang, e seng tlhatlhobo
home.approachLede: Dipapadi tse dintsi tsa “dikelo tsa mogopolo” di agilwe ka lebelo, dipoelo le ditlhopha tsa dikgwedi. Ga motho a lapile, a sa itumela kgotsa a nna le bolwetse jwa go lebala, seo se ka tshwana le tlhatlhobo. Rona re dirile ka tsela e e fapaneng.
home.approachLink: Ke ka go reng re dira ka tsela eno

principles.title: Ga go na se se ka palelang
principles.text: Ga go na nako, dipontsho, ditshwetso kgotsa go lahlega. Ditshwantsho tse di farologaneng ke go ema, e seng phoso.

principles.title: Ditshwantsho di nna di bonala
principles.text: Recognition over recall. Matching starts face up, so there is nothing to remember.

principles.title: Ba bagolo le ba tlotlwa
principles.text: Mafoko a bonolo, a a boitshepo le ditshwantsho tsa lefatshe la nnete. Ga go ke ditshwantsho tsa katuni kgotsa puo ya bana.

principles.title: Sephiri ka tlhamalalo
principles.text: Ga go dikgangiso, ga go akhaonto. Ditshwantsho tsa gago ga di tlogele sedirisiwa sa gago.

home.guidesTitle: Dikaelo tse di tlhamalalo tsa tlhokomelo ya letsatsi le letsatsi

guides.title: Go bapala dipapadi mmogo
guides.text: Go tlhopha, go lebelela go tsamaya ga dilo, le se se tshwanetseng go dirwa fa papadi e tlhoka go itumedisa.

guides.title: Fa ba gana go dira ditiro
guides.text: Mabaka a a tlwaelegileng a go gana, le ditsela tse di boleta tsa go leka gape ka nako e e tlang.

guides.title: Ditiro tsa ditshwantsho tsa sehlopha
guides.text: Ditiro tse di abelanwang tsa tafole e e nang le batho ba le mmalwa, e e nang le tiro e e tlhomameng ya motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe.

guides.title: Dikakanyo tsa ditiro tse 101
guides.text: Dikakanyo tse di bonolo, di beilwe ka se o nang le sone le gore go na le matlhagatlhaga a le kana kang.

home.researchTitle: Bophelo jwa boko: dipatlisiso di bolela eng ka nnete
home.researchText: A dementia e ka thibiwa? A dipapadi tsa boko di thusa? Ka fa go tlhapa, go tlhoka dijo, boroko le go utlwa? Dikarabo tse di tlhomamisitsweng, di bontsha le fa bopaki bo le bofokodi.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities mo iPhone, iPad le Android
home.appText: Application e mahala e dirisiwa fa e se mo inthaneteng, mme e ka dirisa ditshwantsho tsa lelapa tse o di tlhophileng, tse di bolokilweng jaaka dikopi mo sedirisiweng sa gago. Rulaganyo e e tshwanang e e thulaganyang: matlapa a mane a a kgolo, ga go nako, ga go dipontsho.

faq.q: Ke dipapadi dife tse di siameng bagolo?
faq.a: Dipapadi tse di siameng di bonolo, di tlwaelegileng, mme di se na kgatelelo: ditshwantsho tse dikgolo tsa go tshwana, go tlhopha, dipazolo tse di bonolo, go fetsa maele a a itsegeng, go tlhabalabala, bingo ya ditshwantsho le dikhadi tsa puo. Di loga batho ba le bantsi ba bagolo, go akaretsa batho ba nang le bolwetse jwa go lebala. Tlhopho e e siameng ke e motho a e ratang gompieno. Tila dinako, dipoelo le sengwe se se bonalang jaaka tlhatlhobo.

faq.q: A dipapadi tseno di a sireletsega?
faq.a: Ee. Papali nngwe le nngwe le sengwe le sengwe sa go gatisa mo Creative Activities se a sa duelwe, ga go na akhaonto, ga go na go ikwadisa kgotsa go itsenya. Dipapali di sebediwa mo browser ya inthanete mo mogaleng, mo thapuleteng kgotsa mo komputareng.

faq.q: A dipapali tsa boko di thibela dementia?
faq.a: Ga go papadi epe e e bontshitsweng gore e thibela bolwetse jwa go lebala, mme Creative Activities ga e ikaelele go alafa kgotsa go thibela sepe. Dipapadi tsa rona ke tsa boitumelo le go nna mmogo nako, mme tsamaiso epe ya ditiro ga e neele tshedimosetso ya boitekanelo.

faq.q: A dipapali tse di loketse motho yo o nang le Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Ee. Alzheimer's ke yone e e bakang dementia thata go feta tse dingwe, mme dipapali di dirilwe go e loketsa: ditshwantsho tse dikgolo tse di tshwarang go bonala, dikgetho tse dimmalwa, le ga go na sepe se o tshwanetseng go se gopola kgotsa go se fosa. Go tshwanya, go beakanya le go feleletsa maele a a itsegeng di ikaega mo tsebong e e tlhomilweng ka nako e telele, e seng go ithuta sepe se sesha.

faq.q: A batho ba ba nang le dementia e e godileng ba ka dirisa ditiro tse?
faq.a: Gantsi ba ka dirisa, fa go na le motho yo o nnang fa gare ga bone. Simolola ka Batla se se tshwanang ka ditshwantsho tse pedi, Dibapa tsa ditshwantsho ka ditaele tse nne, pampiri ya go tlhoma mebala kgotsa sebaka sa go phefogela ka khutso. Dira gore e nne ya nakwana, latela se ba se batlang, mme o emise fa ba kgora.

faq.q: A tshedimosetso ya me e a ipoloka?
faq.a: Webosaete ga e na dikakanyo tsa akhaonto kgotsa dikgatiso. Re dirisa Google Analytics go tlhaloganya dikarolo tse batho ba di tsenngwang. Ditshwantsho tse o di tlhophang tsa Dibapa tsa ditshwantsho tsa lelapa di bonwa mo browser ya gago fela, mme ga di kitla di tsenngwa mo inthaneteng.

faq.q: Creative Activities e dirwa ke mang?
faq.a: Creative Activities ke sehlopha se sennye sa batho ba ba dirang ditiro tse di kgutsa, tsa bagolo, tsa motho yo o tlhokomelang motho, mo inthaneteng le e le ntlha ya sešwa e e sa duelwe chelete. Ga re badiri ba tša boitekanelo, mme ga go na sepe mo go tse di kwadilweng fano se se leng keletso ya boitekanelo.

home.groupsTitle: Mefuta e mene ya ditiro tse di tlhamaletseng
home.groupsLede: Simolola ka sehlopha se se tshwanetseng motho yo o nnang le ene le se o nang le sone. Tsamaiso nngwe le nngwe e na le ditlhopho tse di bonolo go feta le dikeletso tsa polokego.

groups.title: Dithoro
groups.text: Pampiri, pente, dilo tse di dirisitsweng gape le ditiro tsa matlhatsa, tse di nang le tlhopho e e bonolo go feta mo tirong nngwe le nngwe.
groups.label: Lebelela dithoro

groups.title: Bana
groups.text: Boitlhamelo le papadi tsa bana, ka motho yo mogolo a le gaufi le dikeletso tse di tlhomameng tsa polokego.
groups.label: Lebelela ditiro tsa bana

groups.title: Mmogo
groups.text: Puo, ditshwantsho, nako ya kwa ntle le ditsela tsa go nna gaufi magareng a melemo.
groups.label: Lebelela dilo tsa go dira mmogo

groups.title: Boikhutso jo bo kgutsa
groups.text: Dinako tse di tlhwatlhwa, tse di kgutsa tsa boitlhamelo ka pene, pampiri kgotsa pina. Ga se kalafi.
groups.label: Lebelela boikhutso jo bo kgutsa

playCta.text: Ditshwantsho tse dikgolo, ga go na nako, ga go na dipoelo le ga go na sepe se o tshwanetseng go ikwadisa go sone. Bapalang mmogo mo browser ya gago.

crafts.label: Dithoro
crafts.title: Dithoro tsa Bagolo le Bana
crafts.seo: Dithoro tse di Bonolo tsa Bagolo le Bana, tse di nang le Ditlhopho tse di Bonolo go Feta
crafts.description: Dithoro tse di bonolo tsa bagolo, bana le malapa: pampiri, pente, dilo tse di dirisitsweng gape le tsa matlhatsa, tse di nang le ditlhopho tse di bonolo go tshwara le tse di nnang fa fatshe, ntle le tsebo e e kgethegileng.

kids.label: Bana
kids.title: Ditiro tse di Tlhamaletseng tsa Bana
kids.seo: Ditiro tse di Tlhamaletseng tsa Bana: Boitlhamelo, Dikwamo le Boikhutso
kids.description: Ditiro tse di tlhamaletseng tsa bana: boitlhamelo jwa bana ba bannye, boitlhamelo jwa tsela ya go dira, papadi ya dikwamo, dithoro tsa malatsi a pula le dikakanyo tsa go itokisa, tse di nang le dikeletso tsa polokego le ditlhopho tsa dikwamo.
kids.lede: Dikakanyo tsa boitlhamelo le papadi tsa bana ba mengwaga le ditlhokego tse di farologaneng, di na le dikeletso tse di tlhomameng tsa polokego le motho yo mogolo a le gaufi.

together.label: Mmogo
together.title: Ditiro tsa go Dirwa Mmogo
together.seo: Ditiro tsa go Dirwa Mmogo, Magareng a Melemo
together.description: Ditiro tsa melemo e e feta e le Bobedi kgotsa go feta: dipapadi tsa puo, ditshwantsho, nako ya kwa ntle, dithoro tsa borraagwe le barwawe, le ditsela tsa go nna gaufi go tswa kgakala.
together.lede: Dikakanyo tsa go abelana nako le motsadi, rraagwe kgotsa mmagwe, ngwana, kgotsa tsala, fa gae, kwa ntle, mo ketelong kgotsa go tswa kgakala.

creative-calm.title: Boikhutso jo bo Kgutsa
creative-calm.seo: Boikhutso jo bo Kgutsa: Boitlhamelo jo bo Kgutsang le Ditiro tsa go Ikhutsa
creative-calm.description: Ditiro tse di kgutsang tsa bagolo le batlhokomedi: boitlhamelo jo bo tlhokomelang, go kwala dikgopolo, mmino, dinako tsa dikwamo le mafelelo a letsatsi a a kgutsang. Ke ditiro tsa boitlhamelo, e seng kalafi.
creative-calm.lede: Ditsela tse di bonolo tsa go tlhaela ka pene, pampiri kgotsa pina. Tse ke ditiro tsa boitlhamelo, e seng kalafi, mme ga di tlhoke tsebo epe.

caregiving.description: Ratgeber für Familien, die einen Menschen mit Demenz betreuen: wie Sie gemeinsam spielen können, was Sie tun, wenn die Person Nein sagt, und wo Sie nach einer Diagnose vertrauenswürdige Hilfe finden.
caregiving.lede: Aktivitäten stehen im Mittelpunkt für Familien, die einen Menschen mit Demenz betreuen, und Hinweise, wohin Sie sich für medizinischen und pflegerischen Rat wenden können.

brain-health.label: Tlhokomelo ya boko
brain-health.title: Tlhokomelo ya Boko: Dinyakisiso di Bolelang
brain-health.seo: Tlhokomelo ya Boko le Kotsi ya Dementia: Dinyakisiso di Bolelang
brain-health.description: A dementia e ka thibelwa? Dikakanyo tse di nang le dikgang tse di tlhomologileng ka dibaka tsa kotsi ya dementia, dipapali tsa boko, go itlhaba, dijo, boitapoloso, boroko, kutlo le matshwao a pele a a supang.
brain-health.lede: Dithuto tse dikgolo di bontshang ka se go fokotsa kotsi ya dementia se se kayang go dira, di tlhalosiwa ka botlhaka, go akaretsa gore bopaki ga bo tlhomame kgotsa bo a farologana. Ke tshedimosetso ya kakaretso, e seng keletso ya bongaka.

guide.sourcesNote: Re tshwaya dikhuduego tsa mekgatlho le dithuto tse tsebe e ikaegileng mo go tsone. Nngwe le nngwe e ne e lekolwa fa tsebe e tokafadiwa.

healthNotice.title: Tshedimosetso ya kakaretso, e seng keletso ya bongaka
healthNotice.textHtml: Tsebe e e fa dinyakisiso tse di phatlaladitsweng malapa. E ke ka se go bolelele se se siameng ka motho yo mongwe. Bua le ngaka pele o fetola dijo, go tsamaya ka dinao, boroko, dithuso kgotsa ditlhare tsa tlhokomelo. Fa go na le go lebala ka tshoganyetso kgotsa diphetogo tse di tshoganyetsang, batla thuso ya bongaka ka bonako. Bala tsebiso ya rona ya tshedimosetso ya boitekanelo.

about.title: Eine gemeinsame Aktivität, kein Test
about.seoTitle: Ka ga Creative Activities: Mokgwa wa Rona
about.description: Warum Creative Activities keine Timer, Punkte oder Serien hat, warum Bilder sichtbar bleiben und was wir zur Gesundheit behaupten und was nicht.

about.lede: Creative Activities bietet ruhige Aktivitäten für Erwachsene an, die zwei Menschen Seite an Seite genießen können, ob einer den anderen betreut oder beide einfach gemeinsame Zeit verbringen möchten.
about.bodyHtml:
Für wen es gedacht ist

Für alle, die jemanden betreuen: einen Elternteil, eine Großmutter oder einen Großvater, ein Kind, eine Partnerin oder einen Partner, eine Freundin oder einen Freund, oder einen Menschen mit Demenz. Familien, ältere Erwachsene und Mitarbeitende in Aktivitätsangeboten können alle dieselben Seiten nutzen.

Was wir glauben

Der Sinn einer Aktivität liegt im Moment selbst: einem Gespräch, einem Lächeln, der Freude, zwei Bilder zusammenzufügen, oder einfach im gemeinsamen Dasitzen. Es geht nicht darum, jemanden zu messen, zu drängen oder etwas zu beweisen.

Viele Gehirntraining-Apps sind auf Geschwindigkeit, Punkte, Serien und Stufen ausgelegt. Für einen Menschen, der müde ist, sich nicht wohlfühlt oder mit Demenz lebt, kann sich das wie eine Prüfung anfühlen, die er nicht bestehen kann. Wir haben es genau andersherum gestaltet und halten uns an diese Regeln:

  • Nichts, was man verlieren kann. Keine Uhr, keine Punkte, kein Zugzähler, keine Leben, keine Serien, keine Konfetti und keine Countdowns, auf keinem Bildschirm.
  • Wiedererkennen statt Erinnern. Bilder bleiben standardmäßig sichtbar. Hinweise laden zum Gespräch ein und fragen nie nach Namen oder Erinnerungen ab.
  • Groß, schlicht und ruhig. Große Schrift und Bilder, hoher Kontrast und Bedienelemente, die immer an derselben Stelle bleiben.
  • Würde für Erwachsene. Fotos aus dem wirklichen Leben und schlichte, warme Worte. Keine Cartoons, kein singendes Lob und keine Emoji-Belohnungen.
  • Ein einfacher Ausweg. „Für heute fertig“ ist immer sichtbar. Auf halbem Weg aufzuhören ist ein gutes Ergebnis.
  • Standardmäßig privat. Keine Konten und keine Werbung. Fotos, die Sie auswählen, bleiben auf Ihrem Gerät.

Was wir nicht behaupten

Unsere Spiele und Aktivitäten dienen dem Vergnügen und der Verbindung. Sie diagnostizieren, testen, messen, behandeln, verlangsamen oder verhindern weder Demenz noch die Alzheimer-Krankheit, und niemand sollte sie aus diesem Grund auswählen. Wenn wir über Gesundheitsforschung schreiben, sagen wir klar, wo die Belege schwach sind, und stellen nie eine Verbindung zu unseren eigenen Aktivitäten her.

Wer wir sind

Creative Activities ist ein kleines, unabhängiges Team. Wir sind keine Kliniker. Unsere Ratgeber beruhen auf veröffentlichten Empfehlungen von Organisationen wie dem National Institute on Aging und der Alzheimer’s Association, und jeder Ratgeber nennt seine Quellen. Lesen Sie, wie wir unsere Seiten schreiben und prüfen.

Sagen Sie uns, was helfen würde

Wir würden gerne hören, was für Sie funktioniert und was nicht, besonders von Menschen mit Demenz, pflegenden Angehörigen und Mitarbeitenden in Aktivitätsangeboten. Schreiben Sie an {email}.

editorial.title: Ka Fa Re Kwalang le Ka Fa Re Tlhatlhobang Matlhakore a Rona
editorial.description: Wie Creative Activities seine Aktivitäts- und Gesundheitsseiten recherchiert, schreibt, Quellen beschafft und aktualisiert und was wir niemals veröffentlichen werden.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Dipotso le Dikarabo
faq.seoTitle: Fragen und Antworten zu Creative Activities
faq.description: Antworten auf häufige Fragen zu den Spielen und Aktivitäten: welche Sie ausprobieren können, wie lange Sie spielen sollten, Ideen für Gruppen und für spätere Krankheitsphasen, Gesundheit und Datenschutz.
faq.lede: Dikarabo tse dikhutshwane, tse di bonolo go tswa mo dipotsong tse balesedi ba di botsang gantsi.

items.q: Welche Spiele eignen sich am besten für ältere Erwachsene?
items.a: Dipapadi tse di siameng ke tse di tlwaelegileng, tse di bonolo, tse di sa tlhokeng patelelo, mme tse di siameng ke tse motho a di itumelelang gompieno. Go tlhopha ditshwantsho tse di bonalang, go beya, dipuzzle tse di bonolo, go tlatsa mafoko a a tlwaelegileng, go kgaoletsa dipitse le bingo ya ditshwantsho di dirisega sentle ke batho ba le bantsi. Tlogela dinako, dipalo le sepe se se bonalang jaaka teko.

items.q: A dipapadi tse di fitlhelelwa ka mahala?
items.a: Ee. Dipapadi tsotlhe le ditshwantsho tse di ka gatisiwang ke tsa mahala. Ga go tlhokege akhaonte, go ikwadisa, go tsenya kgotsa dikgwebo.

items.q: Ke eng fa go se na dikgwaokwa, maemo kgotsa dinako?
items.a: Lebelo le dikgwaokwa di fetolela mosebetsi o o itumedisang go nna tlhatlhobo, mme seo se ka tlisa go tlhoname kgotsa go tshwenyega. Re tsepamisa maikutlo mo go itumelelang le go nna le nako mmogo. Ga go na sepe se se tlhokang go fetsa, mme o ka emisa ka nako efe kgotsa efe.

items.q: Ke dikarolo dife tse di dirang sentle thata?
items.a: Mogala ofe kgotsa ofe, thelefono e e nang le sebatlisi sa Inthanete sa segompieno, tabolete kgotsa komputara. Tabolete e e mo setlhoeng mo tafoleng gantsi ke tsela e e itumedisang go nna le batho ba babedi ba bapala ka tlhamalalo. Laptop e e kopantsweng le thelebishene e dira sentle mo dihuduwaneng.

items.q: A re ka bapala ka difoto tsa rona tsa lelapa?
items.a: Ee. Dipapadi tsa difoto di fetolela difoto tse 2 go ya go tse 6 tse o di tlhophang go nna papadi e e kopanyang. Difoto di nna mo sebatlising sa gago, ga di romelwe kgotsa go bolokwa.

items.q: Mosebetsi o tshwanetse go tsaya nako e kae?
items.a: Gantsi metsotso e le 10 go ya go e le 20 e a lekana, mme dinako tse dingwe metsotso e le 2 ke katlego. Lebelela matshwao a go lapa kgotsa go tlhoka mogopolo, mme o emise fa go ntse go utlwala sentle. Ga go na palo e e siameng.

items.q: Go tlhaga eng fa ba sa batle go dira mosebetsi?
items.a: Amogela go gana ga bone, mme o leke gape ka nako e nngwe kgotsa ka tsela e nngwe. Go gana go ka tsiwa ke go lapa, bolwetsi, go se itse sentle, kgotsa go se kgathalale fela. Bala tataiso ya rona ka se o ka se dirang fa ba gana.

items.q: Ke mesebetsi efe e e siameng dikgatlhong tsa bofelo tsa dementia?
items.a: Go itumelela le go utlwa: go reetsa melodi e ba e ratang, go tlhapisa diatla ka lotion, go lebelela difoto mmogo, go tshwara kobo e e bonolo, go nna kwa ntle, kgotsa papadi e e bonolo ya ditshwantsho fa motho a le mo gare. Tataiso ya rona ya dikgatlhong tsa bofelo e na le dikakanyo tse dintsi.

items.q: A go na mesebetsi ya setlhopha mo ntlong ya tlhokomelo?
items.a: Ee. Bingo ya ditshwantsho e na le dikarata tse di ka gatisiwang le motlhankedi wa mo skrineng, mme Tlatsa polelo le Dikarata tsa puisano di dira sentle fa di balelwa ka godimo. Tataiso ya rona ya dihuduwana tsa ntlo ya tlhokomelo e tlhalosa palo ya batho, go nna mo dihutsaneng le go dirisa mesebetsi go batho ba ba nang le dikgono tse di farologaneng.

items.q: A dipapadi di ka thibela kgotsa go diega dementia?
items.a: Ga go papadi e e kileng ya bontshiwa e thibela dementia, mme dipapadi tsa rona ga di dire kgang e e jalo. Go tsosa kelo mo setlhopheng go bontshitse melemo e e nnye mo dinyakisisong tsa batho ba ba nang le dementia e e bonnye go bogolo, mme seo se farologana le papadi e e thibelang bolwetsi. Re fa dipapadi go itumelela le go nna mmogo.

Ga go kgonege go tlhomamisa. Dinyakisiso di kopanya dintlha tse 14 tsa boitekanelo le tsela ya botshelo le kotsi ya dementia, tse kang go senyega ga kutlo, kgatelelo ya madi, go se tsamaye ka mmele le go se kopane le batho. Go tlhokomela tseno go ka fokotsa kotsi ya batho bangwe, mme batho ba le bantsi ba ba dirang tsotlhe ka tsela e e siameng ba tswa ba simolola dementia. Ga e ope molato.

items.q: A go itlhoka dijo ka dinako go molemo mo boitekanelong jwa kelo?
items.a: Bosupi jwa batho bo sa ntse bo le kwa tshimologong mme bo lekanyeditswe, gape dinyakisiso di le dintsi di dirilwe mo diphofung. Go itlhoka dijo go ka nna kotsi go batho ba ba godileng, go tlhokomelwa thata fa ba nwa dithuo tsa sukiri kgotsa fa ba fokotsa boima jwa mmele ka go sa tlhoke. Ga e gakololelwe batho ba ba nang le dementia. Bua le ngaka pele o fetola tsela ya go ja.

Ga go na dikaonte kgotsa dikgwebo tsa ditshwantsho. Re dirisa Google Analytics go bala ditsenelo le go bona dikhutlo tse di thusang, mme sebatlisi sa gago se gakologelwa fa o tlhomile dikgwele tse di bonolo. Difoto tse o di tlhophang tsa Dipapadi tsa difoto ga di kgone go romelwa. Bala Tshedimosetso ya Sephiri go bona dintlha.
Aowa. Creative Activities e ya boikgatiso le tshedimosetso e e tlhamaletseng. Ka dipotso tsa boitekanelo, bua le ngaka, mme ka maemo a tshoganyetso bitsa 999.

handout.title: Dipapadi tse di bonolo, tsa mahala, tsa batho ba ba nang le dementia
handout.seoTitle: Lokwalo lo le ka gatisiwang: Dipapadi tsa mahala tsa dementia mo inthaneteng
handout.description: Lokwalo lo le le ka gatisiwang la leng le le tee la lelapa le ba ba tlhokomelang ka dipapadi tse di bonolo, tsa mahala tsa ditshwantsho tsa batho ba ba nang le dementia, go dikopano tsa thuso le dipakete tsa tlhokomelo.
handout.lede: Gatisa tsebe eno go dikopano tsa thuso, pakete ya tlhokomelo kgotsa lebati la sejanaga. Dirisa taelo ya Gatisa ya sebatlisi sa gago; dikhutlo le dikonopo di tlogelwa mo go gatisitsweng.
handout.introHtml: Ditshwantsho tse dikgolo, mafoko a a bonolo le ga go na sepe se se tlhokang go fetsa. Di mahala mo thelefoneng, taboleteng kgotsa komputareng, ga go na go ikwadisa, dikgwebo, dinako kgotsa dikgwaokwa. Dulang fa thoko ga wa mongwe le mongwe, le fetolane.
handout.restHtml:
Dikeletso tse dingwe

  • Tlhopa nako ya letsatsi fa motho a le sentle thata.
  • Simolola ka tsela e e bonolo thata. Dithaele tse nne di a lekana.
  • Bua ka ditshwantsho. Puisano gantsi ke karolo e e kgolo thata.
  • Emisa fa go ntse go utlwala sentle. Go emisa pele ke bokhutlo jo bo siameng.

Le mo sebakeng sa rona

  • Ditshwantsho tse di ka gatisiwang tsa mahala: lepapatsa la mafoko a a kgolo, ditshwantsho tsa go tlatsa mebala, dikarata tsa puisano le bingo ya ditshwantsho.
  • Dikakanyo tsa mesebetsi ya dikgatlhong tsotlhe, le dikaelo tsa go bapala mmogo le go itlhokomela.

Go itumelela le go nna le nako mmogo. Ga se keletso ya boitekanelo, tlhatlhobo kgotsa kalafi. Creative Activities e gatisitswe ke Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.gamesItemHtml: dipapali tse {count} tsa browser tse di dirang mo laptop, thebolete kgotsa TV e e golaganeditsweng le komputara. Ga go tsenngwa, ga go akhaonto, ga go kgoeletsiwe. Bona dipapali tsotlhe.

organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Mekgwa ya dihuduho: Picture bingo e na le dikarata tse di ka gatisiwang le mmoki mo skrineng, mme dipapadi tsa puisano di na le dipotso tse di nang le dikhetho tsa dikarabo le ditlhagiso tsa go bua.
  • Dikgaolo tsa mekgwa tsa badiredi le malapa, tse di kwadilweng ka puo e e bonolo le dithomo. Simolola ka dikakanyo tse 101 tsa mekgwa kgotsa mekgwa ya dihuduho mo malapeng a tlhokomelo.
organizations.restHtml:
Dihlopha di di dirisa jang

  • Dintlo tsa tlhokomelo le tlhokomelo ya dementia: picture bingo kgotsa go feletsa mafoko mo TV ya phaphatlhana, le motho mongwe a tobetsa ka bothoko jwa bone.
  • Mananeo a letsatsi a batho ba bagolo: seteishene ya thebolete e na le Picture pairs e e beilweng go nna ditlhaka tse nne, bakeng sa dipuisano tse dikhutshwane tsa mongwe le mongwe.
  • Dilaebrari tsa setšhaba: di-word search tse di gatisitsweng le dikaate tsa puisano mo dikitong tsa gopolo, le webosaiti e kaelwa mo dithebolete tsa laebrari.
  • Dihlopha tsa thuso ba ba tlhokomelang le dikopano tsa gopolo: pampiri e le nngwe e e ka gatisiwang ya malapa go isa gae.
  • Dipetlele le ba ba rulaganyang go tswa mo petleleng: pampiri mo dikitong tsa ba ba tlhokomelang, go thusa ka sepe se se bolokang kagiso fa gae kgotsa mo thoko ga bolwetse jwa motho.

Se re sa se dirang

Dipapali di tsa boitumelo le go nna le nako mmogo. Ga di bone, ga di tlhatlhobe, ga di lekanye, ga di alafe kgotsa ga di dire gore dementia e dikadiege, mme re kopa dikgwebo gore di se ke tsa di tlhalosa ka tsela eo. Ga go na dikwadiso, mme dipapali ga di kope maina, tshedimosetso ya bophelo kgotsa go tsenya ditshwantsho. Webosaiti e dirisa Google Analytics go bala ditseno; tsebeletso ya poifo ya rona e tlhalosa se se kokoanyediwang ka yone. Ditshwantsho tse di dirisiwang mo Photo pairs di nna mo browser.

Re tsenye mo lenaneng la gago la dibaka

Fa o na le lenaneng la dibaka tsa ba ba tlhokomelang, o amogelesegile go golagana le {domain}. O ka kopolola tlhalosetso nngwe kgotsa e nngwe.
organizations.linksHtml:
Matlhakore a a siameng a o ka a golagantsang ka tlhamalalo: dipapadi tse di sa lefelwe, ditshwantsho tse di ka gatisiwang tse di sa lefelwe, mekgwa ya batho ba ba nang le dementia mo gae le mokgwa wa go dira dipapadi mmogo.

Dipotso kgotsa diphosho

Fa go na le sepe mo tshimong se se phoso kgotsa se se sa utlwalang, kgotsa fa ditlhokego tsa mothei kgotsa motho yo o tlhokomelwang di sa fitlhelelwe mo se se mo go one, re itse ka {email}. Tsweetswee lo se ka lwa romela tshedimosetso ya botho kgotsa ya boitekanelo ya bathei kgotsa ba ba tlhokomelwang.

app.title: Lenaneo la Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: Lenaneo la Creative Activities la iPhone le Android
app.description: Lenaneo le le sa lefelwe la Creative Activities: go nonofa ditshwantsho ka bonolo ka ditlhaka tse nne tse dikgolo, ditshwantsho tsa lelapa di bolokilwe mo sedirisong sa gago, dipakete tsa ditshwantsho tse di dirisiwang ntle le inthanete le ntle le akhaonto.
app.lede: Sotlhe se o se ratang mo webosaiteng, mo lenaneng le le dirang ntle le inthanete le le ka dirisang ditshwantsho tsa lelapa tse o di tlhophileng.
app.bodyHtml:
Simolola ka bonnye

Simolola ka dipopego tse nne tse dikgolo le difoto tse o di itseng. Difoto di ka nna di bonala, kgotsa di ka fitlhelwa fa seo se lo siela. Mokgwa o o bonolo ga o na nako, palo kgotsa kotlo. Tlhopha dipopego tse 4, 6, 8 kgotsa 12.

Dira gore e nne ya gago

Tlhopha difoto tsa malapa o dirisa thulaganyo ya difoto ya sedirisa sa gago. App e boloka dikopi tse dinnye tsa difoto dipapadi tsa yone. Ga e tlhaelele difoto tsa gago kgotsa e di fetole, mme e boloka go fitlha difoto di le 24 mo kopanong e le nngwe.

Lebang mmogo fela

Lebelelang setshwantsho se le sengwe ka nako. Ditlhagiso tse o di tlhophang di thusa go bua mmogo, mme ga go kopiwe motho gore a gakologelwe maina kgotsa a fe karabo e e nepagetseng. Go lebelela fela go lekane.

Go dirisa ntle le inthanete fa go tlhokega

Difoto tsa tshimologo le dipolokelo tsa difoto tse robedi di akaretswa mo app. Dikopi tsa difoto tse o di tlisitseng di dirisiwa ntle le inthanete. Go tlhopha difoto tse di bolokilweng mo iCloud fela go ka tlhoka inthanete.

Ga go tlhokege akhaonto, ga go na seraboa sa go kopanya difoto

Dikopi tsa difoto tsa malapa di nna mo app mo sedirisong. O ka tlosa dikopi ntle le go phimola difoto tsa gago tsa mathomo. Dipoloko tsa sedirisa di ka akaretsa tshedimosetso ya app. Bala tshireletso ya tshedimosetso ya app, mme thuso ya app e tsamaisa go nna mo go nngwe le nngwe.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities e tlhomilwe go ikhutsa le go bua mmogo. Ga e tlhatlhobe, e alafe, e thibele kgotsa e lekanye dementia kgotsa bolwetsi jwa Alzheimer’s.

faq.q: Re tshwanetse go simolola ka papadi efe?
faq.a: Dipaere tsa difoto tse nne ke tshimologo e e bonolo. Fa go tlhopha pakaretso ya difoto go tlhoka thata, leka Bona se se tshwanang ka difoto tse pedi. Mo sekgoeng, leka bingo ya difoto.

faq.q: A dipapadi di dirisiwa mo iPad kgotsa mo fone?
faq.a: Ee. Papadi nngwe le nngwe e dirisiwa mo browser mo mafoneng, ditableteng le dikhomputareng, mme difoto di oketsega go tlatsa sekrini. Tablete e e emisitsweng ka go lebega e a siama thata go batho ba babedi.

faq.q: A dipapadi di siamela motho yo o nang le Alzheimer’s?
faq.a: Ee. Di dirilwe batho ba nang le dementia, go akaretsa Alzheimer’s, e leng yone e e tlwaelegileng thata. Difoto di nna di bonala, go na le dikgetho di se kae fela, mme ga go na nako kgotsa dipontsho, ka jalo dipapadi di tshwaetse go lemoga dilo tse di tlwaelegileng go na le go gakologelwa tse disha.

faq.q: A ke dipapadi tsa gakologelo tsa baagolo?
faq.a: Ke dipapadi tsa go tlhopha le tsa ditshwantsho tseo motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo o godileng a ka di itumelelang, mme di rebotswe gore di seka tekolo ya gakologelo: mo Picture pairs ditshwantsho di tsaya go nna di bonala ka fa godimo fa o sa tlhophe ka tsela e e farologanyeng. Papadi epe ya gakologelo e ka dirwa e bonolo ka go tlosa nako le dinontsho.

faq.q: A go na le dipapadi tsa dihlopha mo ntlong ya tlhokomelo?
faq.a: Ee. Bingo ya difoto e na le dikarata tse di ka gatisiwang le motho yo o bitsang mo sekrining, mme Tlatsa polelo le Dikarata tsa puisano di siama thata fa di balelwa ka lentswe le le phagameng go sehlopha.

faq.q: A go na le app ya batho ba ba godileng le malapa?
faq.a: Ee. Creative Activities (e e tlhalositsweng e le “{storeName}”) ke ya mahala mo App Store le Google Play. E na le papadi e e bonolo ya go tsenya difoto ka dipopego tse dikgolo, dipapadi tse di nang le difoto tsa malapa tse o di tlhophang, le dipolokelo tsa difoto tse di dirang ntle le inthanete.

faq.q: A app ya Creative Activities ke ya mahala?
faq.a: Ee. E ka tlhatlhobiwa ka mahala, mme ga go na dipapatso, akhaonto kgotsa dithengo mo app.

faq.q: A app e dirisiwa ntle le inthanete?
faq.a: Ee. Difoto tsa tshimologo le dipolokelo tse robedi tsa difoto di akaretswa mo app, mme difoto tsa malapa di dirisiwa ntle le inthanete fa di kopiwa mo app. Go tlhopha setshwantsho se se bolokilweng mo iCloud fela go ka tlhoka kgokagano.

faq.q: A ke ka dirisa difoto tsa rona tsa malapa?
faq.a: Ee. Tlhopha difoto o dirisa setlhopha sa difoto sa sediriswa sa gago. Lenaneo le boloka dikopi tse dinnye mo sedirisong ka dipapali tsa lone, ga le di romele kwa godimo mme ga le fetole difoto tsa tshimologo. O ka tlosa dikopi nako nngwe le nngwe.

faq.q: A ke lenaneo la go tlhatlhoba kgopolo kgotsa la tlhatlhobo ya go gopola?
faq.a: Nnyaa. Creative Activities ke ya go itumela le go nna le nako mmogo. Ga e na dipalo kgotsa diteko, mme ga e tlhatlhobe, e alafe, e thibele kgotsa e ele bolwetsi jwa dementia kgotsa jwa Alzheimer.

Lenaneo la mahala la Creative Activities la iPhone, iPad le Android le na le go tlhopha difoto ka bonolo, ka dithaelo tse dikgolo le difoto tsa lelapa tse o di tlhophileng, mme le dirisiwa ntle le inthanete. gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Ga lo ise lo dire papadi le motho yo o godileng kgotsa yo o nang le dementia? Balang mokgwa wa go dira dipapadi mmogo, go akaretsa se lo tshwanetseng go se dira fa ba latlhegelwa ke kgatlhego.
gamePage.appText: Lenaneo la mahala la Creative Activities le na le go tlhopha difoto ka bonolo, ka dithaelo tse dikgolo le difoto tsa lelapa la gago, mme le dirisiwa ntle le Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad le Android.
gamePage.photoAppTitle: Dira gore difoto tsa gago di nne gone
gamePage.photoAppText: Mo lenaneong la mahala la Creative Activities, difoto tse o di tlhophileng di nna mo sedirisong sa gago gore di nne teng nako e e tlang, mme dipapali di dirisiwa ntle le Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad le Android.
gamePage.goodToKnow: Se se botoka go se itse
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Papali eno ke ya go itumela le go nna le nako mmogo. Ga e tlhatlhobe, e lekanye kgotsa e alafe sepe.
gamePage.moreGames: Dipapali tse dingwe tse di bonolo

print.heading: Papadi mo pampiring
print.sameRules: Mokgwa wa pampiri o na le melao e e tshwanang le papadi e e mo skrineng:
print.pageNote: Tsebe e le nngwe ya A4 kgotsa US Letter, e siame mo go ntsho le go tshweu. Phatlalatso {date}.
print.islandNote: E gatisa se se mo skrineng jaanong. Phatlalatso {date}.
print.point: Mo pampiring, supang setshwantsho e seng go se tobetsa, kgotsa se tikologe ka pene. Mola o mongwe le o mongwe ke seto se sesha.
print.pointTarget: Mo pampiring, setshwantsho se se lebelelwang se mo lebokoseng ka fa tshimologong ya mola o mongwe le o mongwe. Supang setshwantsho e seng go se tobetsa, kgotsa se tikologe ka pene.
print.halves: Setshwantsho se seng le se seng se gapiwa bogare. Dirang tlhaka go tswa mo karolong nngwe e e ka letsakeng go ya go karolo e e tshwanetseng mo letsakeng le le labo, kgotsa supang ka monwe. Ga go tlhokege go gaola sepe.
print.grid: Sekwere se seng le se seng se na le nomoro. Batlang nomoro eo mo tlhalosong, mme tlhalang sekwere ka pensele ya ngwao eo. Ngwao nngwe epe e o e batlang le yone e siame fela. Ga go tlhokege go gaola sepe.
print.colors: Mola o mongwe le o mongwe o bidiwa ka ngwao. Supang setshwantsho se se nang le ngwao eo, kgotsa se tikologe ka pene. Mola o mongwe le o mongwe ke seto se sesha.
print.dice: Mola o mongwe le o mongwe ke seto sa dikubu. Tlhophang mola, kgotsa gaolang ditshwantsho o di tlhope go tswa mo lotlhakeng, mme o bolelele pale o dirisa tsone ka tatelano epe. Mongwe le mongwe a ka tlola.
print.words: Gaolang mantswe, kgotsa dirang tlhaka go tswa mo lefokong go ya kwa setshwantsheng sa one. Balang mantswe ka go godisa fa lo tsamaya.
print.cards: Gaolang dikarata go latela mela e e thibegang. Di beang fa godimo mo tafoleng, mme lo batle dipaere.
print.chain: Mo pampiring, balang ditshwantsho go tswa kafa letshoenyana go ya kafa go le letshehere, e le nngwe ka morago ga e nngwe. Motho mongwe le mongwe a bue poloko e le nngwe ka ditshwantsho tse di fitlhetsweng, mme a supe setshwantsho se se latelang. Mongwe le mongwe a ka tlola.
print.sort: Gaolang ditshwantsho go latela mela e e thibegang, mme tsenyang setshwantsho se sengwe le se sengwe mo lebokoseng le se tshwanetseng go nna teng.
print.puzzle: Gaolang setshwantsho se segolo go latela mela e e thibegang go nna dikarolo tse nne, mme lo di tsose. Fetolanyang dikarolo tse pedi ka nako go fitlha setshwantsho se le feletseng. Setshwantsho se sennye ke tataiso.
print.cutSafety: Mothusi a ka gaola pele lo simolola. Morago ga moo tlosang dikhutshwana.

reasons.photos: Ga go na mokgwa wa pampiri. Papadi eno e dirisa difoto tsa gago, tse di nna mo browser ya gago mme ga di tsenngwe kwa godimo, ka jalo lefapha ga le kgone go di gatisa. Go dira papadi mo pampiring, gatisang dikopi di le pedi tsa difoto tse di mmalwa tse lo di ratang mo gae, mme lo di tlhophe mo tafoleng.
reasons.paced: Ga go na mokgwa wa pampiri. Sediko se beela sekgwa se se diregang le se se sa fetoge mo skrineng, mme tsebe e e gatisitsweng e ke ke ya dira seo, ka jalo e tla nna tiro e nngwe. Go tshwaela mmogo ntle le skrine ke tlhopho e e tsamaisanang ka nako epe.
reasons.turns: Ga go na mokgwa wa pampiri wa papadi eno. Go batla dipaere mo tafoleng, gatisang dikarata tsa ditshwantsho tse di tswang mo Picture pairs, mme lo dirise mekgwa e e fetolanang go di fetolela.
reasons.screen: Ce ga go na le mokwalo wa pampiri. Ke setshwantsho sa go lebelelwa mmogo mo skrineng; setshwantsho se se ratwang kgotsa postekhate mo tafoleng se dira ntlha e le nngwe.
reasons.wash: Ga go na mokwalo wa pampiri. Pentshe ya metsi mo pampiring ke tlhaloso e e tshwanang: borashe e e metsi le mmala o le mongwe ka nako.
reasons.sayings: Ga go na mokwalo wa pampiri ga jaanong. Mo pampiring dikgwetlho tsotlhe di ne di tla bonala ka nako e le nngwe, mme kgato e e boleng jo bo bonolo ya "Bontsha bokgwetlho" e ne e tla latlhega. Bala diane mo skrineng mmogo, kgotsa abelanang tse dintsi tse lo di itseng ka tsone.
